title: Implement Secure Data Access Layer
problem_statement: Replace ADO direct SQL execution with parameterized queries and ORM to prevent SQL injection
risk_if_unaddressed: Critical security vulnerability allowing unauthorized data access and manipulation
suggested_approach: Implement Entity Framework Core with parameterized queries and connection pooling
success_criteria: Static analysis shows no SQL injection vectors

provenance.evidence: ADO 2.5 reference indicates direct SQL usage

title: Modernize Authentication and Authorization
problem_statement: Replace basic login form with modern authentication supporting MFA and role-based access
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to financial data and transactions
suggested_approach: Implement ASP.NET Core Identity with JWT tokens and role-based authorization

provenance.evidence: Single login form without modern security

title: Implement Audit Trail and Logging
problem_statement: Add comprehensive audit logging for all financial transactions and user actions
risk_if_unaddressed: Regulatory compliance violations and inability to track unauthorized activities
suggested_approach: Implement structured logging with Serilog and audit database tables
success_criteria: All transactions logged with timestamps and user context

provenance.evidence: Transaction forms without visible audit mechanisms

title: Replace COM Dependencies
problem_statement: Eliminate COM component dependencies that create deployment and maintenance issues
risk_if_unaddressed: Deployment failures and compatibility issues on modern systems
suggested_approach: Replace with native .NET controls or modern web UI components

title: Implement Data Encryption
problem_statement: Add encryption for sensitive financial data at rest and in transit
risk_if_unaddressed: Data breach exposing customer financial information
suggested_approach: Implement TLS for transport and AES encryption for sensitive database fields
